notes.title: v1.1Optimized Hitting Sensation
notes.content:
1. Optimize and upgrade the sense of attack comprehensively, strengthen the feedback of attack, increase the "ten frames" effect after hitting the target, and make the attack more "thick".
2. Added special effects such as spark after hitting the target to make the attack more cool.
